start.speaker: Innkeeper
start.text: Federal Chain? Out here? It'll be about the Harrow place, then. Burnt from the inside and not a spark seen from the street.

who.speaker: Innkeeper
who.text: Old Harrow. Kept to himself. Paid the guild for his kitchen stove, he said, though nobody ever saw it lit.

smoke.speaker: Innkeeper
smoke.text: None. Not a wisp. Just a light in his window, bright as noon, for about the length of a breath.
